{# LEFT: Table Card — uses workbench_table macro. min-w-0 overrides the flex item's default min-width:auto -- without it, a flex child containing a wide table cannot shrink below the table's intrinsic width, so the browser can't compute a correct scroll boundary for the table's own overflow-x-auto container. The visible symptom (H3) was the sticky "Actions" column's right:0 anchor landing mid-table instead of at the real scrolled edge, overlapping Status/Contract. #}
{# Two empty states, chosen by hasActiveFilters (search or a filter is applied): nothing exists yet, or nothing matches what was asked for. The shared table only takes static text, so the message and the action are passed as markup and bound here. #} {# data-testid/role match the house empty-state convention used elsewhere, e.g. archimate_crud/partials/_repository_workspace.html's true/filtered empty states. #} {% set _vendor_empty_title %} {% endset %} {% set _vendor_empty_action %} {# Distinct accessible name from the header's own "Add Vendor" action (page_header's `actions=`, above): both are visible together whenever the table is empty, and identical names made get_by_role('button', name='Add Vendor') ambiguous -- caught by tests/smoke/test_vendor_dialog_controls.py, whose own selector is (rightly) unscoped since it targets the header action specifically. #} {% endset %} {% call workbench_table( columns=[ {'key': 'row_number', 'label': '#'}, {'key': 'name', 'label': 'Vendor', 'sortable': true}, {'key': 'vendor_type', 'label': 'Type'}, {'key': 'products_count', 'label': 'Products'}, {'key': 'enterprise_readiness_score', 'label': 'Readiness'}, {'key': 'status', 'label': 'Status'}, {'key': 'contract_status', 'label': 'Contract'}, {'key': 'mcda_score', 'label': 'Score'}, {'label': 'Actions', 'align': 'right'}, ], filters=[ {'key': 'vendor_type', 'label': 'Types', 'options': vendor_type_filter_options or []}, {'key': 'contract_status', 'label': 'Statuses', 'options': [ {'value': 'catalog', 'label': 'Catalog'}, {'value': 'contracted', 'label': 'Contracted'}, {'value': 'deployed', 'label': 'Deployed'}, {'value': 'inactive', 'label': 'Inactive'}, ]}, ], selectable=true, search_placeholder='Search vendors...', empty_icon='building', empty_message=_vendor_empty_title, empty_description=_vendor_empty_action, per_page_default=25 ) %} {# ── Page-specific cell templates (repeated per row by Alpine x-for) ── #}
